## Level-Up Flow

**When offered:** Worker decides via `shouldLevelUp(character)` (`worker/src/services/character.ts:159`) = `xp >= XP_THRESHOLDS[level]` (thresholds 0/300/900/.../64000, `types/index.ts:175`) and `level < 10`. Returned as `canLevelUp` by `POST /api/action` and `POST /api/combat/resolve`. UI shows a banner (`character-sheet.component.html:66`) and ability picker (`game-console.component.html:19-28`).

**Trigger:** `levelUp(key)` in `game-console.component.ts:183` → `GameApiService.levelUp(sessionId, characterId, abilityChoice)` (`game-api.service.ts:74`).

**Endpoint:** `POST /api/levelup` (`worker/src/routes/levelup.ts:10`). Body: `{ sessionId, characterId, abilityChoice }` (one of str/dex/con/int/wis/cha); 400 if invalid ability or `!shouldLevelUp`.

**Changes on character** (`services/character.ts:133` `levelUp`):
- Level +1
- HP gain = `roll(class hit die) + CON mod`, added to both `max_hp` and current `hp` (hit dice: Fighter/Ranger d10, Rogue/Cleric/Bard d8, Wizard d6)
- Chosen ability score **+2** (not capped at 20)
- AC unchanged

Response is `{ narrative, updatedCharacter, abilityImproved, newLevel }`; a `[Level Up]` system log row and DM history turn are added. Frontend calls `setCharacter`, `setCanLevelUp(false)`, shows a system message. One level per call — needs repeated calls if XP exceeds multiple thresholds.
